items.title: Skip a word Anki won't take
items.line: Needs you names the word and why; Skip this word makes the rest of the part's cards.

items.title: A subtitle you re-timed is seen
items.line: Not timed? Fix it beside its video, then Check again on its row.

items.title: It closes when you do
items.line: Surasura's helpers close with it; what was waiting picks up next time.

items.title: Ready for hato's subtitles from the audio
items.line: A subtitle hato makes from an episode's audio is read as that episode's.

items.title: Anki Miner opens once
items.line: Open Anki Miner says it's already open instead of starting a second copy.

items.title: Setup on an empty library says what to add
items.line: Add a show first, or sort one out of New arrivals into Current.

items.title: Removed's Bring back is always there
items.line: Shown once the library answers, even while it's busy.

items.title: Report a problem fits a short screen
items.line: It stays on the screen, and scrolls.
